scripts.dev:concurrent: concurrently "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.sync: cd backend && bun run sync:daily && bun run sync:starred:recent
scripts.sync:all: cd backend && bun run sync:trending && bun run sync:starred
scripts.data:update: bun run sync && bun run data:export
scripts.build:static: cd backend && bun run export:incremental && cd ../frontend && VITE_STATIC_MODE=true bun run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck
